title: Blocks and Tables · Binary W2D DWF
description: Official Autodesk binary WHIP!/W2D ePlot sample. This is the default demo because it loads quickly and gives a clear first impression of the WebGL vector backend.
descriptionZh: Autodesk 官方二进制 WHIP!/W2D ePlot 示例，默认加载，观感清晰且打开速度快，用于验证 WebGL vector backend。

title: AutoCAD R14 · Legacy ASCII DWF V00.34
description: Dependency-free regression fixture for pre-DWF-6 readable WHIP!/W2D streams, including multiline point sets, palette colors, triangle strips, fill state, visibility, and source background.
descriptionZh: 早期 AutoCAD 可读 ASCII DWF V00.34 回归示例，覆盖跨行点集、调色板、三角带、填充、可见性和源文件背景。

title: Autodesk Floor Plans · 2D DWFx/XPS
description: Multi-page architectural DWFx/XPS sample. Switch to A03 First Floor Plan to validate XPS WebGL rendering, embedded fonts, thin-line overview, and zoom performance.
descriptionZh: 多页建筑图纸示例，可切换到 A03 First Floor Plan，用于验证 XPS WebGL、嵌入字体、细线总览与缩放性能。

title: Robot Arm · 3D eModel DWFx
description: Real W3D/HSF shell geometry sample with assembly tree, materials, textures, and feature edges.
descriptionZh: 真实 W3D/HSF shell 几何、装配树、材质、纹理与特征边示例。

title: Minimal XPS · DWFx
description: Small DWFx/XPS FixedPage sample for validating the DWFx OPC/XPS path.
descriptionZh: 小型 DWFx/XPS FixedPage 示例，用于验证 DWFx OPC/XPS 路径。

title: Textual W2D · DWF
description: Textual W2D container sample for smoke tests and regression checks.
descriptionZh: 文本型 W2D 容器示例，用于 smoke test 和回归测试。
